newsitem.title: USA: NASD awards McMahan $3 mln from Forum Capital.
newsitem.headline: NASD awards McMahan $3 mln from Forum Capital.

text.p: The National Association of Securities Dealers' said Tuesday that it has awarded $3 million to McMahan Securities Co, a convertible securities broker-dealer in its dispute wit Forum Capital Markets L.P.
The award will be paid by Forum, its founders and principals, for "breach of fiduciary, contractual and statutory obligations, misappropriation of assets and tortious interference," said the NASD.

All eight of the individuals against whom monetary awards were made were former McMahan partners and employees. The amounts assessed against them ranged from $1 million to $50,000. Assessments were also made against the principal partnership entities they formed.

The New York Supreme Court issued a temporary restraining order on January 30 enjoining the individuals against whom monetary awards were levied from transferring any assets "with the intent to hinder, delay or defraud" McMahan's enforcement of the award.
